verses.text: Someone who shuts everyone out chases their own interests and pushes back against all sound judgment.
A fool has no interest in understanding. They just want everyone to hear their opinion.
When wickedness shows up, contempt follows. Shame comes with disgrace.
A person's words are like deep waters. Wisdom's fountain is like a flowing stream.
It's wrong to play favorites with the wicked or deny innocent people justice.
A fool's words start arguments, and their mouth invites a beating.
A fool's mouth is their undoing. Their own words are a trap for their life.
Gossip goes down like tasty bites, all the way into a person's deepest parts.
Someone who slacks off at work is kin to someone who makes a mess of everything.
The LORD's name is a strong tower. People who do right run there and are safe.
A rich person's wealth is their fortified city. In their imagination, it's a wall nobody can climb.
Pride takes over the heart before ruin. Humility comes before honor.
Answering before you've heard the whole thing is foolish and embarrassing.
Your spirit can carry you through sickness. But who can bear a crushed spirit?
A discerning heart gains knowledge. Wise ears listen for it.
A gift opens doors for the giver and brings them before people of influence.
The first person to make their case sounds right until someone else comes and questions them.
Casting lots settles disputes and keeps powerful opponents apart.
An offended brother is harder to win back than a fortified city. Arguments are like the bars of a fortress.
The fruit of a person's words fills their stomach. The harvest of their lips satisfies them.
The tongue has power over death and life. Those who love to use it will eat what it produces.
Anyone who finds a wife finds a good thing and receives favor from the LORD.
Poor people plead for mercy. Rich people answer harshly.
Having lots of companions can lead to ruin, but there's a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
